# Policy Summary: Evergreen Hospital Cash Plan

Larkspur Mutual Life Insurance Company

Issued: 1 August 2026

## 1 About this policy

The Evergreen Hospital Cash Plan from Larkspur Mutual Life Insurance Company pays a cash benefit when you are admitted to hospital or have surgery because of an illness or an injury. This summary sets out the points you should check before you buy.

## 2 Period of cover and who can apply

| Item | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Period of cover | 1 October 2026 – 30 September 2027 (renewed each year) |
| Age at entry | 20 to 70 |
| Waiting period | 30 days |

You can apply up to the age of 70.

The waiting period is 30 days. A hospital stay for an illness that starts within this period after the start date is not covered.

## 3 Benefits

| Benefit | Amount | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hospital cash | $100 a day | 60 days a stay |
| Surgery | $1,000 an operation | 10 operations |
| Outpatient | $50 a visit | 30 visits a year |

Hospital cash is paid at $100 for each day you are in hospital.

The outpatient excess is $20 a visit, and the most we pay for a visit is $50.

## 4 Premium

| How you pay | Premium |
| --- | --- |
| Monthly | $24 |
| Annually (12 monthly payments) | $288 |

Your premium is set by your age when you join and is worked out again at each renewal.

## 5 Main exclusions

1. A hospital stay for an illness that started before the start date
2. An injury you cause on purpose
3. An injury caused by war or civil unrest
4. Cosmetic surgery
